names.note: Read out of «Свешт. муч. Автоном.» in this folder’s Serbian citation.

death.note: saint.gr: stoned while celebrating the liturgy, in 313.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Автонома, еп. Италийского (313)»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.09.2026 (12. септембар ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Автоном.“

hymns.text: Ἐκ Δυσμῶν ἀνατείλας ὡς ἀστὴρ οὐρανόφωτος, καὶ πρὸς τὴν Ἐώαν ἐκλάμψας, ταὶς ἀκτίσι τῶν τρόπων σου, τὸν Ἥλιον τῆς δόξης Ἰησοῦν, ἐδόξασας ἀθλήσει σου στερρῆ· διὰ τοῦτο ἐδοξάσθης θεουργικῶς, Αὐτόνομε Πατὴρ ἠμῶν. Δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοὶ ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σου, πάσιν Ἰάματα.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Αυτόνομος, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: Having risen from the West as a star lit with the light of heaven, and having shone forth unto the East with the rays of thy manner of life, thou didst glorify Jesus, the Sun of glory, by thy steadfast contest; and for this cause thou wast glorified by the working of God, O Autonomus our father. Glory to him who gave thee strength; glory to him who crowned thee; glory to him who works healings for all through thee.

hymns.text: Trupul tău cu posturi topindu-ţi, cu neadormite rugăciuni pe Făcătorul ai rugat pentru păcatul tău, ca să iei iertare desăvârşită; şi ai luat iertare, calea pocăinţei arătând.

english.text: Melting thy body away with fastings, with unsleeping prayers thou didst entreat the Creator concerning thy sin, that thou mightest receive perfect forgiveness; and thou didst receive forgiveness, showing forth thereby the way of repentance.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinţite Mucenice Avtonom, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

english.text: Being both a partaker of the ways and a successor to the thrones of the apostles, thou didst find activity, O inspired of God, to be the ascent of contemplation unto things on high. Wherefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in the faith even unto blood, O Hieromartyr Autonomus, intercede with Christ God that our souls may be saved.
